title: Only displays the last four digits of the ticket number
goal: Use the negative subscript of slice to truncate the end of the string.
summary: The ticket number consists of English letters and numbers. Only the last four digits will be displayed on the receipt, and all old tickets will be displayed if there are less than four digits.
tasks: completes lastDigits(ticket) and returns the last four characters of the string.
is less than four characters, the entire ticket number is returned, with leading zeros retained.

example.note: Negative subscripts count forward from the end of the string. The result of slice is still a string.

hint: uses slice(-4) directly. Converting the ticket number to a numerical value will lose the leading 0's.
